requirements: R1: Each rental vehicle starts in the Available state at the rental location.
R2: When a customer creates a confirmed reservation for an Available vehicle, the system moves the vehicle to Reserved.
R3: When a walk-in customer is approved by an agent for an Available vehicle without prior reservation, the system moves the vehicle directly to Rented after license verification.
R4: When the assigned customer completes pickup with a valid driver license while the vehicle is Reserved, the system moves the vehicle to Rented.
R5: When the customer returns the vehicle on time while Rented, the system completes inspection and moves the vehicle to Available.
R6: When the customer returns the vehicle after the due time while Rented, the system records late fees, completes inspection, and moves the vehicle to Available.
R7: When damage is recorded during return inspection while Rented, the system moves the vehicle to Maintenance.
R8: When maintenance work is completed while in Maintenance, the system moves the vehicle to Available.
R9: When a reservation is cancelled before pickup while the vehicle is Reserved, the system releases the reservation and returns the vehicle to Available.
R10: The system must not move a vehicle to Rented unless a valid driver license was verified at pickup.
R11: The system must not assign the same vehicle to two active reservations simultaneously.
R12: When returned fuel level is below the minimum required level while Rented, the system records a refueling charge before moving the vehicle to Available or Maintenance.
